note: memory cell of push 8. Doubled coordinates; unit u = cells with x in {2u, 2u+1}; tr(c, k) = (x + 2k, y, z - 2k). A state 'letters' = capL + for each letter i (hex digit h) the stators and the sites of h moved to unit 4 + i + capR moved to unit 4 + N. runs[].ops = [generation, cells removed (each must be live)]; runs[].checks = [generation, letters]: the whole state equals the state of those letters. H = side of the oracle's cubic torus.

runs.name: smallest
runs.text: the smallest cell found (73 cells): set, add one, count read (two pulses out), empty again

runs.name: count
runs.text: set; three pulses add one each (right, left, right); count read: four pulses leave, the cell is empty again

runs.name: transfer
runs.text: two stores: the count read of the right one (3) sends three pulses to the left one (1), which then holds 4

runs.name: bit-empty
runs.text: bit read of an empty cell: the pulse crosses the wire and the right cap swallows it

runs.name: bit-set
runs.text: bit read of a cell that holds a stretch: the pulse is absorbed (count 1 becomes 2), nothing reaches the far side
